dropped.checklist_item: - [ ] Strengthen test_inbound_differ_uses_injected_mapper to assert the injected mapper's sentinel output surfaces as an observable mutation in `_muts` (e.g., a status change to "closed"), mirroring the outbound test's output assertion.
evidence: tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_backend_neutrality.py:222 `_muts, _ = inbound_differ.compute_inbound_mutations(` — return value bound to `_muts` then never asserted
tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_backend_neutrality.py:228 `assert fake.calls, "the injected inbound_mapper was never called"` — sole assertion
_RecordingInboundMapper.map_remote_to_local returns {"status": "closed"} (test_backend_neutrality.py:163-165) while local ticket status is "open" (line 221), so a status mutation should be produced
inbound_differ.py:190-192 and 218-230 confirm a mapped status differing from local yields an entry in `changed` → an observable inbound mutation
Contrast: the outbound test asserts observable output at test_backend_neutrality.py:213 `assert result[0].fields == {"summary": "SENTINEL-FROM-INJECTED-MAPPER"}`
dropped.finding: test_inbound_differ_uses_injected_mapper asserts only that the injected mapper was called (`assert fake.calls`) and discards the returned mutations (`_muts`), so it cannot detect a regression where the injected inbound_mapper is invoked but its mapped result is not propagated into the emitted mutation. Its outbound sibling (test_outbound_differ_uses_injected_mapper) correctly asserts the observable output (`result[0].fields == {"summary": "SENTINEL-FROM-INJECTED-MAPPER"}`); the inbound test should assert the analogous observable post-condition — that the sentinel status `"closed"` (which differs from the local `"open"`) surfaces as a status mutation in `_muts`.
dropped.suggested_fix: After the call, assert the sentinel propagated, e.g.: `assert any(getattr(m, "field", None) == "status" and getattr(m, "value", None) == "closed" for m in _muts)` (adapt to the InboundMutation field/value accessors), rather than relying solely on `fake.calls`.
